physicalEvidence.summary: Full February 2023 ICRA paper implements DDPG actor/critic networks with two300-unit hidden layers to output thruster forces, converted to PWM. The learned controller executes onboard a real ASV on the Charles River using onboard lidar/IMU SLAM. Reported tracking error is lower than NMPC while physical actuator-force variation/effort is higher; favorable simulated energy results must not be transferred to the river experiment. This is prior MIT research. Current Wisconsin2026 fish and FloatForm work verify active physical robotics, but use bioinspired mechanics or classical coordination rather than newly proven neural control. The current lab lists2025 residual-model-learning MPC research; full implementation details were not recovered, so no added hardware credit inferred.
